Let the stars sing! Let the planets shout! Let the Republic begin!|Excerpt from the Declaration of a New Republic|<ref name="Chronology">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>}}
The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''4 after the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''Year 39 after the Great ReSynchronization''' and '''Year 1004 after the Ruusan Reformation''', was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that saw great upheaval in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The first month of the year saw the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], one of the most decisive battles of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]&mdash;the battle saw the destruction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Palpatine's death largely fragmented the Empire, with many Imperial officers becoming warlords and seizing territory, and the Rebel Alliance established the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] as a transitional civilian administration as part of the formal creation of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in the month after [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The first few months after the Battle of Endor also saw the [[Bakura Incident]], the first alliance&mdash;albeit a temporary one&mdash;between the Empire and the Alliance, and also the [[Nagai–Tof War]] as the extra-galactic [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] [[Species/Legends|species]] invaded. Some factions temporarily set this year as 'year 0', until the establishment of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]-based calendar [[25 ABY/Legends|two decades later]].

==Events==
*End of the [[Virgillian Civil War]].
*[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] announces his intent to sponsor a [[Jabba's demolition games|vehicular demolition tournament]] in response to the outlawing of [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracer]] [[Pugwis]] is invited by Jabba to be the first competitor due to his racing tactics inspiring the idea to begin with.<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars: Demolition]]''</ref>
*The twin [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] [[Tia (pilot)|Tia]] and [[Ghia]] desert the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and steal a [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] in an attempt to rescue [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from Jabba Desilijic Tiure, departing for [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name=":0" />
*General [[Otto]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] deserts his post in fear of his life after repeated failures against the Rebel Alliance. He travels to Tatooine to compete in Jabba's demolition games to win enough money to quietly retire to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name=":0" />
*[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] enters Jabba's demolition games.<ref name=":0" />
*Wade Vox is captured by Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal forces for refusing to pay "docking fees" and forced to enter Jabba's demolition games.<ref name=":0" />
*The [[Wookiee]] [[Quagga]] enters Jabba's demolition games in an attempt to save his business from failing due to interference from local [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].<ref name=":0" />
*Tia and Ghia arrive on Tatooine and attempt to rescue Han Solo from [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. Their attempt fails and they are captured by Jabba's forces and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]. After discovering that the twins are Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], Jabba forces them to participate in his demolition games, falsely promising them their freedom in return.<ref name=":0" />
*[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] infiltrates Jabba's Palace as a [[Skiff guard/Legends|skiff guard]] and enters Jabba's demolition games in an attempt to curry favor with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
*Jabba Desilijic Tiure orders his beastmaster [[Malakili/Legends|Malakili]] to enter his demolition tournament atop his prize [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]].
*The Jawa warlord [[Wittin/Legends|Wittin]] enters Jabba's demolition games to build resources for his attempt to conquer the other Jawa clans of Tatooine.<ref name=":0" />
*[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] arrives at Jabba's Palace in disguise as the [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] and claims the bounty for Han Solo's Wookiee partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> She later enters Jabba's demolition games to cement her position.<ref name=":0" />
*[[Oola/Legends|Oola]] is thrown into the rancor pit by Jabba Desilijic Tiure for refusing his advances after a rendition of [[Jedi Rocks/Legends|Jedi Rocks]]. She is eaten by [[Jabba's Rancor]].<ref name="ROTJ" />
*The [[Cyborg/Legends|Cyborg]] [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]] arrives at Jabba's Palace in pursuit of the rogue administration droid [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]]. He is captured and slated for execution, but Lobot's friend Lando Calrissian (disguised as the skiff guard [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Tamtel Skreej]]) convinces Jabba to spare him and enter him in the Hutt's demolition games instead.<ref name=":0" />
*The bounty hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] arrives at Jabba's Palace after sensing the presence of a [[Force-sensitive|Force-Sensitive]]. She enters Jabba's demolition games after discovering captive smuggler Wade Vox is her target.
*Wade Vox manages to escape with his life from Jabba's demolition games and construct his own crimson [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Aurra Sing pursues him, but her initial attempt to kill him is easily deflected.<ref name=":0" />
*Pugwis is eaten by the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]] during an accident out in the dunes while riding his [[Pugwis' Custom Podracer|podracer.]] Jabba was riding his [[Khetanna/Legends|sail barge]] nearby, and was amused after witnessing the incident.
*Tia and Ghia survive Jabba's demolition games, but learn that the Hutt had no intention of granting them their freedom. Jabba forces the twins back into servitude as his personal slaves.<ref name=":0" />
*Boba Fett is honored by Jabba for his performance in the demolition games.<ref name=":0" />
*Quagga earns enough money from his performance in the demolition games to open a new [[Quagga's Garage|garage]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], where he sold his [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|AAT]] to a band of Jawas.<ref name=":0" />
*Lando survives the demolition games, but his poor performance leads Jabba to punish him before his court by forcing him to eat one of the Hutt's snacks.<ref name=":0" />
*Wittin also survives Jabba's demolition games and purchases his own Sand Crawler.<ref name=":0" />
*Leia Organa reveals her identity to Tia and Ghia and helps them escape from Jabba's throne room. She leads the twins to the palace gates, where a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] is waiting to return them to the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet.]] The twins escape from Tatooine and return to active service in the Alliance's effort to [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|restore the Galactic Republic]].<ref name=":0" /> Princess Leia remains behind to rescue Han Solo.<ref name="ROTJ" />
*Jabba's demolition games officially come to an end.<ref name=":0" />
*Han Solo is saved by Princess Leia Organa from [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|prison]].<ref name="ROTJ" />
*Princess Leia Organa is unmasked and captured by Jabba Desilijic Tiure after attempting to rescue Han Solo. She is forced into indentured servitude to the Hutt as his personal slave.<ref name="ROTJ" />
*Jabba's rancor is killed during the attempted execution of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="ROTJ" />
*Princess Leia Organa kills Jabba Desilijic Tiure by strangulation over the pit of Carkoon, after which she and Luke Skywalker destroy Jabba's prized sail barge, ''The Khetanna'', during their [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|escape]].
*[[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] family started to lose their power and influence after the death of Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
*Permanent dissolution of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and temporary dissolution of [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]]
*Luke Skywalker returned to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] to complete his [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]], as he had promised to his [[Yoda/Legends|mentor]] a [[3 ABY/Legends|year earlier]], but Yoda died of old age before he could do so. However he told Luke he must confront [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to become a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="ROTJ" />
*[[The Force/Legends|The Force]] was brought back into [[Chosen One/Legends|balance]] when Anakin Skywalker destroyed the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> However the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] lived on, since [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Essence transfer|transferred his essence]] to [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of himself on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] for the first time.<ref name="TNEC" />
*The Galactic Empire began its fragmentation after the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] Palpatine, his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], Darth Vader, and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Second Death Star]] over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="ROTJ" />
*[[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88's]] [[Droid Revolution]] came to an end after its destruction with the second Death Star.
*With the Rebel Alliance's celebration on the Sanctuary Moon, [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on Endor became the successor of [[Haven Base]] on [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]] as the command centre of the Rebel Alliance.
*An [[Coruscant uprising|uprising]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was brutally quashed by [[Ysanne Isard]], [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]].
*The [[Ssi-ruu]]k attacked [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], bringing about the [[Bakura Incident]].<ref name="Truce" />
*The Rebel Alliance [[Declaration of the Alliance of Free Planets|establishes]] the transitional [[Alliance of Free Planets]] in the wake of the fragmentation of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Truce Source" />
*[[Zsinj's Empire]] was formed.
*The [[Restored Empire]] was formed.
*The [[Pentastar Talks]] lead to the signing of the [[Pentastar Alignment Treaty]] and the establishment of the [[Pentastar Alignment]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*Formation of [[Lumiya's Sith]] by [[Lumiya]].
*The [[Nagai–Tof War]]&mdash;the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] invaded a number of planets, including Endor, [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]] and [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]].<ref name="Forgotten War">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref>
*The Alliance to Restore the Republic was reorganized into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] with the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|Declaration of a New Republic]] signed, and the [[New Republic Provisional Council]], one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the Declaration of the Alliance of Free Planets.
*39:09:26&mdash;At the behest of Commander Luke Skywalker via Alliance Command, the New Republic publicized annotated copies of the [[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide|''Imperial Handbook'']], including some commentary made by [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
*[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] finally lost its [[Planetary shield/Legends|shielding]] due the malfunction.<ref name="DE">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref>
*[[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] was [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|liberated]] by the New Republic.<ref name="Atlas" />
*39:9<ref name="Date">{{FactFile|96|MON 1-2|''Mon Remonda''}} dates this event to six months after the Battle of Endor, which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to 39:3.</ref>&ndash;The New Republic approves plans for the [[MC90 Star Cruiser|MC90 cruiser]].<ref name="FF96">{{FactFile|96|MON 1-2|''Mon Remonda''}}</ref>
